documentation.content: No active instance of the Cloud Run service __SERVICE__ (__STAGE__) for 5 minutes. The service should never scale to zero (min instances 1): a revision is failing to start or the service was paused. Check Cloud Run → __SERVICE__ → Revisions and the logs ("apps/api will not start").

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name = "__SERVICE__" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/container/instance_count" AND metric.labels.state = "active"
